label: lem:mvt
title: Mean Value Theorem
statement: Let $G : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $G' : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, with $a < b$. Suppose $G$ is continuous on $\mathrm{Icc}\; a\; b$ and satisfies $\texttt{HasDerivAt}\; G\; (G'\; x)\; x$ for all $x \in \mathrm{Ioo}\; a\; b$. Then there exists $c \in \mathrm{Ioo}\; a\; b$ such that $G'(c) = (G(b) - G(a))/(b - a)$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}.
proof: This is a standard Mathlib result (\texttt{exists\_hasDerivAt\_eq\_slope}).
